comments: bca39a19: This code block initializes variables and sets up the environment for processing Deficiency Tracking records.
3c833e84: Initialize variables and retrieve node and parameter information from the Deficiency Tracking and Division files.
fef34871: Check for the existence of the detailed node; if it exists, load it.
caab9f97: Capture the current date and set the flag for determining if a record is overdue.
6c7ccfec: If the record status matches certain criteria, mark it for processing.
f4baee1d: End of the main routine, proceed to quit.
368a604f: For records marked 'INCOMPLETE', calculate if they are overdue based on the parameters and set flags accordingly.
20b4aa95: For records marked 'DICTATED', automatically set the flag indicating processing is needed.
4d735e7f: For 'TRANSCRIBED' records, determine if they are overdue and set flags if so.
052ce069: Similar check for 'SIGNED' records, to see if they are overdue based on the signing date.
96626cb7: End of the PROC subroutine, proceed to quit.
a53db662: Calculate the number of days late for a record.
d1ecaa78: Calculate the total time until a record is considered late.
93dfb691: Handle cases where there is no discharge date but there is a signed date, adjust counters and flags accordingly.
71f6de36: Update the dictation overtime counter and mark the period as requiring attention.
a694080a: For records with a transcription date, update the transcription overtime counter.
f5f43f20: If a transcription date exists, proceed to calculate overtime based on coding completion.
ee1e7fd5: Calculate and set overtime based on coding date if available.
fb4b18dc: End of the SET subroutine, proceed to quit.
db7bbb90: Retrieve the patient's discharge date from the Patient Movement file if available.
90d2190a: Mark the record for special attention if no discharge date can be found.
5a8d5039: End of the COD subroutine, proceed to quit.
294e4a1b: Update the counters for coding overtime and mark records with flags as needed.
